properties.entry: SELECT I.INVITE_NUM, G.GROUP_NAME, U.USER_NICKNAME AS INVITER_NAME, I.CREATED_AT FROM INVITATIONS I JOIN GROUPS G ON I.GROUP_NUM = G.GROUP_NUM JOIN USERS U ON I.INVITER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE I.INVITEE_NUM = ? AND I.INVITE_STATUS = 'P' ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC
UPDATE INVITATIONS SET INVITE_STATUS = ? WHERE INVITE_NUM = ?
SELECT GROUP_NUM, INVITEE_NUM FROM INVITATIONS WHERE INVITE_NUM = ?
